'''''AZ 77''''' was an [[XQ3 Platform]] manufactured by the [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Corporation]] that operated as a salvage yard. It was seized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for harboring fugitives, including a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]].

==Layout==
The Platform was well armed, and was escorted by ''[[Sague]]'', a a group of three [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class shuttles]], as well as the [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] ''[[Nemzet]]'', the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Thunder (Y-wing)|''Thunder'']], and the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Renspecs]]''. It was maintained by a repair crew which flew the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Poltroon]]''.

==History==
AZ 77 was originally a salvage yard, and was used to harbor criminals, [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] tracked by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The spy had a modified [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|transport]] that could outrun the Empire's [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]].

Because of the transports' speed, a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]], escorted by [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Avengers]], was deployed to capture the spy. The Platform launched the transports [[Lin (starship)|''Lin'']], ''[[Ko]]'', and ''[[Kaar]]'', escorted by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], but all three were disabled by the TIE Defender's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] before they could escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Glory]]'' arrived to oversee the Platform's capture of the Platform, and launched [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] and [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|assault transports]] to disable AZ 77.

The events of the battle around AZ 77 were recorded and recreated for training purposes in the [[Combat chamber]], allowing future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] including [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] to prepare for official tours of duty.

==Behind the scenes==
AZ 77 shares the same name and model with [[AZ 77|another Platform]] in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], which was officially a Rebel supply depot.
